literal: Those who lack love, everything to themselves they claim; those who possess love, even their bones belong to others.
translation: Those who lack love claim everything for themselves; those who possess love yield even their very bones to others.
modern: அன்பு இல்லாதவர்கள் எல்லாப் பொருட்களையும் தமக்கே உரியதாகக் கொள்வர்; அன்பு உடையவர்கள் தம் உடம்பையும் பிறருக்கு உரியதாக்குவர்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the selfish nature of those who lack love with the ultimate selflessness of those who possess it. People without love seek to hoard everything, believing that all things belong solely to them. In stark contrast, those filled with love are so generous that they consider even their own physical bodies, represented here by bones, as belonging to others. The word 'enpu' (bone) is used metaphorically to signify the most fundamental, innermost part of one's physical existence, highlighting that true love knows no boundaries of self-preservation.
